title: W10785366A — Refrigerator service mode entry
description: Recommended + Drawer 5 sec; navigate with Icemaker2 / Up / Down / Fast Cool.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Enter refrigerator service mode
steps.body: Hold Recommended and Drawer buttons together 5 seconds (chime). Icemaker2 = Enter; Up/Down = navigate; Fast Cool = Back. Hold Up to reach WiFi tests 106+.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold Recommended and Drawer simultaneously 5 seconds.
